'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*Aftermath of the [[October 2021 Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan protests]]
**[[Saad Hussain Rizvi]], the leader of the [[Far-right politics|far-right]] [[Islamic extremism|Islamist]] party [[Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan]], is released from prison under a deal to end weeks of protests by his followers, which resulted in the deaths of dozens of people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-frees-hardline-islamist-under-deal-end-violence-2021-11-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[22nd Annual Latin Grammy Awards]]
**The 22nd Annual [[Latin Grammy Awards]] are held at the [[MGM Grand Garden Arena]] in Las Vegas, Nevada. Colombian singer [[Camilo (singer)|Camilo]]  was the most awarded artist with four wins. [https://www.billboard.com/music/latin/2021-latin-grammys-winners-list-1234999583/ (''Billboard'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Germany]]
*****The [[Standing Committee on Vaccination]] recommends that a [[booster dose]] of an [[mRNA]]-based [[COVID-19 vaccine]] should be given to all adults over the age of 18 years. [https://www.dw.com/en/covid-germany-recommends-booster-shot-for-everyone-over-18/a-59852732 (Deutsche Welle)]
****[[Germany]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 65,371 new cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/germany-reports-record-65-371-new-covid-19-cases/2424033 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports a record 15,145 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,011,465. [https://www.krone.at/2558712 (Kronen Zeitung)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece|Greek]] [[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] announces that beginning on November 22, unvaccinated people will be banned from entering all indoor venues for which they could previously present a negative [[COVID-19 test|test]] result, due to an increase in new COVID-19 cases. Mitsotakis also announces that [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|vaccine passport]]s will expire after seven months for people over the age of 60 years and urges people in this age group to receive a booster dose. [https://greekreporter.com/2021/11/18/greece-bars-unvaccinated-closed-venues/ (Greek Reporter)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 23,860 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2021/11/coronavirus-cases-set-new-record-for-fourth-day-in-a-row/ (Dutch News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 1,251 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 260,335. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/11/18/russia-sees-second-day-of-record-covid-deaths-despite-declining-cases-a75598 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Laos]]
****[[Laos]] reports a record 1,041 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 58,798. [https://vnanet.vn/Frontend/TrackingView.aspx?IID=5777145 (Vietnam Plus)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 3,292 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 406,605. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20211118000184 (''The Korea Herald'')]
*A lab in [[Montgomery County, Pennsylvania]], [[United States]], is placed on temporary lockdown by the [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|CDC]] after several vials labeled "[[smallpox]]" are discovered in a freezer. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/smallpox-vials-lab-freezer-pennsylvania-cdc/ (CBS News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis]]
**[[Government of Belarus|Belarus]] suspends electricity supplies to [[Ukraine]], in "accordance with the established procedure for interaction within the framework of contractual relations", according to a statement from the Belarusian Ministry of Energy. [https://ukranews.com/en/news/814995-belarus-to-stop-supplying-electricity-to-ukraine-on-november-18 (Ukranews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*At the [[Birmingham Crown Court]] in England, Zephaniah McLeod is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to at least 21 years imprisonment for [[manslaughter]] and four counts of [[attempted murder]] after killing one person and wounding seven others during a 90-minute stabbing spree in September 2020. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-birmingham-59292090 (BBC News)] 
*The [[New York Supreme Court]] vacates the convictions of [[Muhammad Abdul Aziz]] (formerly Norman 3X Butler) and the late Khalil Islam (formerly Thomas 15X Johnson) for the [[assassination of Malcolm X|1965 assassination]] of [[Malcolm X]]. The two men were convicted alongside [[Thomas Hagan]] (formerly Talmadge Hayer) in 1966. An investigation led by [[Manhattan District Attorney]] [[Cyrus Vance Jr.]] discovered that the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] and the [[New York City Police Department|NYPD]] had withheld evidence that would have acquitted Aziz and Islam. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/17/nyregion/malcolm-x-killing-exonerated.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Vladimiro Montesinos]], adviser to former [[President of Peru|Peruvian President]] [[Alberto Fujimori]], is sentenced to 17-years in prison for the kidnapping of left-wing journalist [[Gustavo Gorriti]]. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/11/19/peru-former-alberto-fujimori-adviser-sentenced-to-17-years-in-prison (MercoPress)]
